summary: Completed frontend-only E2E testing of NULLAI V1 static landing page. All 14 functional checks from the review request pass: brand bar, ZeroLogo SVG with ring-mask + binary scroll, hero copy (headline + subheadline), CTA Manifesto (href/target/rel), Donation modal open + full address + Copy feedback + ESC/overlay close, 3 feature cards (Vortex/Shield/ZKBurn) with correct name+description, footer GitBook/X external links with target=_blank, Basescan rendered as non-clickable <span> with 'pending' text, disclaimer text, pure black background (rgb(0,0,0)), and mobile (375x812) layout stacking CTAs with the 0 logo remaining centered.

issues: The external 'Made with Emergent' floating badge (injected by the Emergent preview environment, not by the app) overlaps the last line of the hero subheadline ('core protocol'). This is environment-side chrome and not controlled by the app source, but users on the preview URL will see the overlap. On the production deploy (without the badge) this is fine.

Hero section uses min-h-[100svh] with justify-between and an oversized ZeroLogo (viewBox 400x600, max 560px wide). On a 1920x1080 viewport the headline + CTAs sit near the bottom of the first fold — fine, but on shorter/taller viewports this is very sensitive. Not a bug, just a note.

critical_code_review_comments: ZeroLogo.jsx: lines array uses start = (i * 13) % seed.length and slices 80 chars from `big` — works because big is grown to 220 chars, but relying on seed.length (64) * 13 modulus is fine; no issue.
DonationModal copy fallback uses document.execCommand('copy') which is deprecated but acceptable as a clipboard API fallback for sandboxed browsers. State toggle works in both paths.
Footer FooterLink disabled branch: since siteConfig.links.basescan is null, the disabled={!siteConfig.links.basescan} prop resolves to true — rendered as <span> with 'pending' text. Correct.
siteConfig is imported in multiple components — good centralization.
App.js wraps AppShell in BrowserRouter with a catch-all '*' route — acceptable for a single-page static manifest but technically unnecessary; could be simplified.
No data-testid on the modal close (X) button — minor, ESC and overlay both close the dialog so not blocking.
File sizes: all components <150 lines, well within limits. No DRY violations, no async/DB concerns (static only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static React landing page — no backend, no routes other than '/'. All interactive elements have data-testid. Desktop viewport 1920x1080 and mobile 375x812 both verified. Copy button label becomes uppercase 'COPIED' via CSS — compare with case-insensitive match. Overlay click closes shadcn Dialog when clicking near viewport corner (10,10).
